name: @veris-ai/veris-sim-opencode
description: Test an application against Veris - stateful twins of the external services it calls, using the Veris CLI or an existing plugin-managed session. Three commands: setup (wire a repo once), build <issue|prompt> (measure the vendor before designing, prove the change with a receipt), fix <issue|prompt> (reproduce the failure first, prove it closed).
author: Veris (https://veris.ai)
